messages:
maria-gh: hey team — opened a small docs PR to add a tenant example for the Dedicated catalog flow and clarify isolation annotations. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123

maria-gh: main things in the diff: added a hands-on tenant example (terraform + SDK snippet), clarified autoscale policy defaults, and a short note on SLA wording when using reserved pools. asking for quick review + link validation before i merge.

alex-k: looking now. quick flag: in the SLA paragraph you say "best-effort preemption" — that could be interpreted badly by sales. can we reword to "may be subject to preemption under reserved-pool contention; refer to SLA matrix for committed capacity guarantees"?

samir: small nit: terraform example had an extra indent causing the snippet to render as plain text in the site. i dropped a fixed block below. also the autoscale snippet needs min_replicas not min_instances for the CLI example.

samir: ```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "tenant-a" {
  name            = "tenant-a-pool"
  gpu_type        = "a100-80gb"
  reserved_amount = 4
  isolation_label = "tenant:tenant-a"
}
```

linh: good catch samir. also can we add a tiny Go SDK snippet? folks keep asking for language examples. something like:

linh: ```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp, err := client.Dedicated().CreatePool(ctx, redwood.CreatePoolParams{
  Name:           "tenant-a-pool",
  GPUType:        "a100-80gb",
  ReservedAmount: 4,
})
// handle resp/err
```

maria-gh: thanks — i added both fixes in the branch. @kb-maintainer can you double-check the migration link for reserved-pool tenant mapping? i referenced the migration guide but didn't include the concrete tf example there yet.

kb-maintainer: I skimmed. we should add a short note about tenant id mapping when customers bring existing reserved pools — specifically the `tenant_id` -> `isolation_label` renaming. propose adding a TOC anchor and a 2-line explanation + link to the migration checklist.

alex-k: also add QA note about rolling back a canary rollout if isolation constraints block fallback. one sentence is fine.

maria-gh: added KB note + anchor and a rollback QA line. leaving the SLA rewrite to alex if that looks ok i'll merge after link checks.

alex-k: wording looks fine now. approved. :thumbsup:

samir: ran the docs build locally, rendering looks good. snippets show syntax highlighting and the terraform block renders correctly now.

docs-bot: PR #4123 — CI docs-lint passed, linkcheck passed (1 warning: internal anchor not found, resolved in latest commit).

maria-gh: rebase and merge in 5 if no objections.

deploy-bot: docs-site: deployment queued for staging — https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/changes/4123 — ETA ~6m

deploy-bot: deployment successful — staging build 2026-03-21T15:30Z — preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/catalog/tenant-examples#tenant-a

maria-gh: merged + smoke-checked the staging page. looks good. thanks all! :party:
